newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti PC in $100 mln facility via Merrill Lynch.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti PC in $100 mln facility via Merrill Lynch.

text.p: Olivetti Personal Computers, recently bought from Italian hi-tech group Olivetti by Piedmont International S.A., has completed the first stage of its capitalisation, a statement said.

In addition to the provision of half the planned $80 million of equity capital for the group, a further $100 million secured facility is being provided through senior debt arranged by Merrill Lynch International in London.
Olivetti PC group Chief Executive Alessandro Barberis described the completion of the purchase and financing as the launchpad for the company's future.

"With the resources now available to us and our strengthened management team, Olivetti Personal Computers is fully equipped to resume its place as the leading European supplier of technology," he said.

At a meeting in Rome last week with Industry Minister Pierluigi Bersani, Piedmont International Chairman GianMario Rossignolo was congratulated for securing a financial base which will restore Olivetti PC as a leading competitor in world markets, the statement said.
